title: Report a chat
summary: Reports a DM or a group to the Bipe team, with an optional reason. In the same step the user can block the person (DM), delete the DM, or leave the group.

otherUserId.description: DM only: the other person, for block.

reason.description: What happened, as typed. Can be empty.

phase.description: sent: a toast with bipe_dm_reported or bipe_app_group_reported, then the screen closes. failed: bipe_app_report_chat_error, nothing was sent.

send.effect: Room.reportRoom with the trimmed reason. Then, in order: Client.ignoreUser (alsoBlock), the dm-delete write (alsoDelete), Room.leave (alsoLeave). A failed follow-up step does not undo the report: for a leave, show bipe_dm_report_leave_failed_body.

notes: The report goes to the homeserver admins, which is the Bipe team (Matrix report room API). Under end-to-end encryption the team cannot read the messages; the footers say so. Never promise a reply or an action.
A DM never offers a leave (ADR 0141): delete is the dm-delete marker, so the other person's next message would bring the DM back unless the user also blocks.
Report of one message is part of the message actions in the timeline (Room.reportContent, timeline interactions spec, bipe-chat/bipe#559), not this screen.
Opens from person-profile (DM), group-details (group) and a chat request.
The send button uses the destructive style.
